title: Bejeweled 2 Deluxe
notes: Played a full game until no more moves.
issues: Under Sikarugir, I was unable to open the game in windowed mode, it would just show a black screen. It would open in fullscreen, but then I found I was unable to type my name when prompted. Switching the engine to Crossover 26.3 fixed both issues. Gameplay is a bit laggy and the most significant lag happens during the 3D transitions between levels. I tried turning off hardware acceleration and high resolution and they seemed to help a little bit. However I then tried to turn back on high resolution for a larger window and it caused the game to crash to a black screen. I noticed that fullscreen mode runs a little better, but when I tried to go back to windowed mode it black screened again. Every time it black screened, I have to do a force quit for it to close. It also takes about a minute to open the game.
